Exile: Put a card into the exile zone; it leaves all other zones. (moves a card to the exile zone—out of play until something brings it back)
Explore: Reveal top library card; if land, put it in hand, else put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and that card in graveyard. (reveal top; land goes to hand, otherwise +1/+1 counter and nonland to graveyard)
Fateseal: Look at top card of a library; you may put it on the bottom.
Fight: Each of two creatures deals damage equal to its power to the other. (the two creatures each deal damage equal to their power to the other—no combat step)
Food: Create a Food artifact token {2}, {T}, Sacrifice: gain 3 life.
Forage: Exile three cards from your graveyard or sacrifice a Food to pay a forage cost.
Goad: Until your next turn, that creature attacks each combat if able and attacks a player other than you if able. (that creature must attack if it can and should attack someone other than you)
Heist: Exile top of libraries face down; you may cast those cards for a time; see printed rules.
Incubate: Create an Incubator token with N +1/+1 counters; {2}: transform it into a Phyrexian artifact creature.
Investigate: Create a Clue artifact token {2}, Sacrifice: draw a card.
Learn: Choose to discard a card to draw one, or put a Lesson card from outside the game into your hand.
Manifest: Put top library card face down as a 2/2 creature; turn face up for its mana cost if it's a creature card.
Manifest dread: Look at top two cards; manifest one and put the other into graveyard or back on top.
Meld: Combine two named cards into one oversized permanent; see meld rules.
Mill: Put that many cards from the top of a player's library into their graveyard. (move cards from the top of a library to the graveyard—count matters)
Monstrosity: If this creature isn't monstrous, put +1/+1 counters on it and it becomes monstrous; triggers may occur.
Open an Attraction: Roll to open an Attraction artifact from the Attraction deck.
Planeswalk: Move to the next Plane or Phenomenon in a Planechase game. (if the defending player controls a Planes land, one creature usually cannot block this alone)
Play: Put a land onto the battlefield or play a spell following timing rules.
Plot: Exile this from hand face up; cast it on a later turn for plot cost without paying mana.
Populate: Create a token that's a copy of a creature token you control.
Prepared: Counters on permanents that modify spells; set-specific.
Proliferate: Choose any number of players and/or permanents with counters; give each another of each kind of counter it has.
Regenerate: (Legacy) Replace the next destroy event this turn with tap, remove from combat, and remove all damage.
Reveal: Show the card to all players; it stays in the zone unless an effect moves it.
Role token: Create a Role Aura enchantment token (Young Hero, Monster, etc.) attached to target creature.
Roll to Visit Your Attractions: Roll die to trigger Attraction visit abilities.
Sacrifice: Put a permanent you control into its owner's graveyard. (you choose one of your permanents and put it into the graveyard)
Scry: Look at the top N cards of your library; put any number on the bottom and the rest on top in any order. (peek at the top; you choose what goes back on top vs bottom)
Seek: Put a random card of the chosen type with mana value N or less from your library into your hand.
Set in motion: Begin a scheme in Archenemy or similar printed rules.
Support: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
Surveil: Look at the top N cards; put any number into your graveyard and the rest on top in any order. (peek at the top; some cards may go to graveyard instead of back on top)
Suspect: A suspected creature has menace and can't block or be untapped by untap step.
Tap: Turn a permanent sideways to show it's been used or is attacking (unless vigilance). (turn sideways to mark used or attacking—untap step stands it up again unless an effect says not)
Time Travel: Adjust time counters on permanents or follow set rules for time travel.
Transform: Turn a double-faced permanent to its other face; follow transform rules.
Treasure: Create a Treasure artifact token {T}, Sacrifice: add one mana of any color.
Untap: Rotate a tapped permanent upright; some costs use the untap symbol on tapped permanents.
Venture into the dungeon: Enter the first room of a dungeon or advance to the next room of the dungeon you're in.
Vote: Players vote from listed choices; apply results as printed.
Waterbend: Avatar set mechanic; follow printed instructions.
Adamant: Bonus if you spent three mana of one color to cast this spell. (extra reward if three mana of one color went into casting this)
Addendum: Bonus if you cast this spell during your main phase. (extra reward if you cast it during your main phase)
Alliance: Triggers whenever another creature enters the battlefield under your control.
Battalion: Triggers when this creature attacks with at least two other creatures. (fires when this attacks alongside at least two other attackers)
Bloodrush: Discard from hand while attacking to buff an attacking creature for its bloodrush cost.
Celebration: Some effects care if two or more nonland permanents entered under your control this turn.
Channel: Discard this card from hand to pay channel cost for a one-shot effect.
Chroma: Counts colored mana symbols among permanents you control; effects vary by card.
Cohort: Tap an untapped creature you control with sufficient power: get a printed bonus.
Constellation: Triggers whenever an enchantment enters the battlefield under your control. (fires when any enchantment enters under your control)
Converge: Effects scale with how many colors of mana you spent to cast the spell. (effect scales with how many colors of mana you spent to cast the spell)
Corrupted: Some effects care if an opponent has three or more poison counters.
Council's dilemma: Players vote between two options; tally votes for the outcome.
Coven: You control three or more creatures with different powers.
Delirium: Bonus if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard. (bonus if your graveyard has four or more different card types)
Descend: Tracks how many permanents went to graveyards this turn for thresholds on the card.
Domain: Effects scale with the number of basic land types among lands you control (max five). (effect scales with how many basic land types your lands have—max five)
Eerie: Triggers when a facedown permanent you control turned face up or an enchantment entered under your control.
Eminence: Static or triggered ability works from the command zone before commander is cast. (works from command zone even before you cast the commander—read card carefully)
Enrage: Whenever this creature is dealt damage, its enrage ability triggers.
Fateful hour: Bonus if you are at or below a life total threshold (often 5) when you cast or activate.
Fathomless descent: Counts permanents that left the battlefield this turn for scaling effects.
Ferocious: Bonus if you control a creature with power 4 or greater when the effect checks. (bonus while you control a creature with power 4 or greater)
Flurry: Copies or bonuses based on how many spells you've cast this turn—read the card.
Formidable: Bonus if creatures you control have total power 8 or greater. (bonus while your creatures total power 8 or greater)
Grandeur: Activated ability on some legendary creatures using cards in hand.
Hellbent: Bonus while you have no cards in hand.
Hero's Reward: Promo/acorn frame reminder; use printed text if any effect.
Heroic: Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, heroic triggers. (fires when you cast a spell that targets this creature)
Imprint: Exile a card as part of the effect; other abilities refer to exiled cards.
Infusion: Counters that grant power/toughness and keywords on modified creatures.
Inspired: Whenever this creature becomes untapped, inspired may trigger.
Join forces: Other players may help pay mana; effect scales with total paid.
Kinfall: Breaches and kin from exile; follow Lost Caverns of Ixalan rules on the card.
Kinship: At upkeep, look at top of library; reveal a creature that shares a type to cast it.
Landfall: Whenever a land enters the battlefield under your control, landfall triggers. (fires each time a land enters under your control—order on stack can matter)
Landship: Counts lands that entered under your control this turn. (counts how many lands entered under you this turn)
Legacy: Acorn or special format text; read the card.
Lieutenant: Bonus while you control your commander. (bonus while your commander is on the battlefield under your control)
Magecraft: Whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery spell, magecraft triggers. (fires when you cast or copy an instant or sorcery)
Metalcraft: Bonus while you control three or more artifacts. (bonus while you control three or more artifacts)
Morbid: Bonus if a creature died this turn before the effect resolves or triggers. (bonus only if a creature already died this turn before the check)
Opus: Epilogue split cards have a second spell-like text after the main spell resolves.
Pack tactics: At beginning of combat, bonus if you attack with total power 6 or greater. (at start of combat, bonus if your attackers total power 6+)
Paradox: Cares about spells cast from zones other than hand this turn.
Parley: Each player reveals top card of library; effects scale with total mana value revealed.
Radiance: Choose a permanent; copy the effect for each other permanent that shares a type with it.
Raid: Bonus if you attacked with a creature this turn. (bonus only if you attacked with a creature earlier this turn)
Rally: Creatures may enter with +1/+1 counters when a rally ability resolves.
Renew: Vehicle set mechanic; read printed card.
Revolt: Bonus if a permanent you controlled left the battlefield this turn. (bonus only if your permanent left the battlefield this turn)
Secret council: Hidden simultaneous choices or votes; follow printed card.
Spell mastery: Bonus if an instant or sorcery is in your graveyard as this resolves.
Start your engines!: Marks cards that interact with max speed / mayhem in their set.
Strive: Pay additional cost for each target beyond the first.
Survival: Counts creatures that survived combat or damage this turn—per card.
Sweep: Return any number of lands of a type you control to hand for a scaling effect.
Teamwork: Voting or blocking bonus when creatures attack you; read printed card.
Tempting offer: Starting with you, each player may accept a resource; effects scale with acceptances.
Threshold: Bonus while you have seven or more cards in your graveyard (older cards vary). (bonus while your graveyard has seven or more cards—unless the card says otherwise)
Underdog: Bonus while an opponent has more life than you (or other printed comparison).
Undergrowth: Abilities scale with +X where X is creatures in your graveyard (or as printed).
Valiant: Triggers the first time each turn this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability.
Vivid: Counts vivid colors among permanents you control; rare keyword—read the card.
Void: Pay extra costs involving exiling cards from graveyard on some Eldraine cards.
Will of the council: Players vote from listed choices; apply the outcome as printed.
